sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: So, overall we're in decent shape.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Uptime last quarter was 99.2 percent, just under our commitment to customers.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: 99.2 percent, really?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: What caused the gap?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Mostly the one outage in the second month.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: How did reliability look last quarter?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We hit 99.2 percent uptime, slightly below what we promise customers.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay, 99.2 percent, noted.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That's almost entirely from the single outage in month two.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I see.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: A quick word on security.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The penetration test found no critical issues and two medium ones, both already fixed.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: That's reassuring.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The team did a great job.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Anything from the penetration test?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: No critical findings, two medium ones, and we've fixed both.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Good.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Credit to the team.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: How is the hiring going for the platform team?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We've filled one of the three roles, and the other two are at offer stage.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Good progress.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: On hiring for the platform team.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: One role is filled, and the remaining two have offers out.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: That's good progress.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: It took a while.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: I want to be upfront about technical debt.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: About a quarter of our engineering time now goes to fixing old issues instead of new features.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: That's more than I'd expect.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: It's been growing.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: You mentioned technical debt in your email.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Yes, roughly a quarter of engineering time is spent on old problems rather than new work.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: That seems high.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: It's crept up.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: What do customers say about the new release?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Support tickets about bugs went down {PERCENT} since the release.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Hmm, {PERCENT}, okay.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Which is the best signal we have.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Great.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Bug-related tickets dropped {PERCENT} after the new release.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Huh, {PERCENT} is more than I expected.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: So customers are happier?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That's how we read it.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: One dependency to mention.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Our cloud provider is retiring the region we use, and we have to move by {DATE_ABS}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Is that a big job?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Manageable, but it takes people off other work.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Are there any external dependencies?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: One, our cloud region is being retired, and we need to migrate before {DATE_ABS}.
